notes: Searches: all 8 used, budget reached. Fetches: about 61, including redirects followed. Verdicts: 20 publish, 1 not_a_group, 2 out_of_area. Key findings for the owner. (1) Most national finders are browsable or partly so (RRCA state list, USA Pickleball club list, WFTDA list). USMS, USA Fencing, USATT, USA Cricket and USA Cycling are form only, map only, or empty, so their Philadelphia clubs were found by search or the club's own pages instead. (2) The RRCA Pennsylvania list has no clubs inside the city; all are suburban and are leads. (3) Most groups do not publish a cost, so cost is unknown for most records. The owner may want a plan to collect fees. (4) No mixed-ability rugby club was found in Philadelphia. The two rugby clubs say players of all experience levels are welcome. (5) The disc alliance record is low confidence and dormant because its own site was blocked; it needs a check before it is shown. (6) The Fencing Academy of Philadelphia looks like a commercial school, so it is not_a_group; the owner should decide. (7) Several Schuylkill Navy club sites are thin: Bachelors Barge has placeholder text, Philadelphia City Rowing returned 403, and Pennsylvania Barge did not resolve. (8) The vocabulary has no tags for ultimate or table tennis. Those records use sports-teams and leave interests empty. Consider adding tags for ultimate and table tennis. (9) Search summaries were used only to find names and leads, and facts came from the groups' own pages where possible. Some older news facts are used only where dated and labeled.
